# TopologyNeural_Mapping

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that maps neural network architectures onto topological network structures, preserving both connectivity and computational semantics. This enables direct implementation of neuromorphic algorithms on TCC-inspired hardware, reducing translation overhead.
